\item \textit{Notes:} Dates are interval-end dates (ET); Obs.\ and the rolling estimation window $W$ are in the units of each panel. The burn-in, 3{,}125 intervals, is the longest HAR horizon and is applied to each series as built (the closing-interval series, the intraday grid and, for the linear pre-sample, the series of the two intervals of the last hour), so the closing-interval sample starts in 2010 and the pre-sample in 2004. The pooled linear models use $W = 96{,}000$ intervals (2{,}000 trading days); the tree pre-sample is re-estimated every 250 intervals. Each validation sample follows a 25-day gap and a 2{,}000-day estimation sample (Section~\ref{sec:rh_methods_tuning}). Full trading days: expiration days that are not early-close days.
